title: Projects
fallbackToFile: No project record in the database passed the check, so the projects from the settings file apply. Fix the records below.
defaultMoved: Instead of {{configured}} set in the file, {{actual}} opens: the configured project is hidden or that environment no longer exists.
ignoredInFile: Projects deleted on this page are still in the settings file: {{list}}. Remove them from the file.

loadFailed.title: Could not load projects
loadFailed.text: The Threadline server did not respond to the project settings request. Try again.

source.off: Projects are read from the settings file. Editing on this page needs a database: set the THREADLINE_DATABASE_URL variable and restart the server.
source.connecting: The database is not connected yet: {{message}}. Projects from the settings file are shown, so a project hidden on the page is visible again and projects created on the page are missing. Editing is disabled.
source.error: The database is not ready: {{message}}. Projects from the settings file are shown. Editing is disabled.
source.stale: The database is unavailable: {{message}}. Settings are as of {{time}}, search works. Editing is disabled.

hiddenNotice.page: The project is hidden: it is not in the project list. Edits are saved and do not unhide it.
hiddenNotice.file: The project is hidden because it was removed from the settings file. “Show” keeps it on the page.

list.title: All projects
list.lead: A project is a system whose logs Threadline searches. Each has its own environments and its own catalog.
list.empty: No visible projects. Turn on “Hidden” or add a project.

action.hideLast: Cannot hide: there are no other visible projects

stores.scopeOpen: Boundary removed: the form can read any value of label {{label}}
stores.noScope: Boundary not set: the form does not save new conditions. An administrator sets backends.{{id}}.formScope in the settings file.
stores.newGrafana: New Grafana or Loki: an administrator adds the log storage to backends (type loki-grafana or loki) with formScope, sets the credential variables and restarts the server. It then appears in the list.
stores.newLocal: New Grafana or Loki: connect it on the storages page, no restart needed. It then appears in the list.

probe.hint: A request goes to log storage only when you click.
probe.failed: Check not run: the Threadline server did not respond.
probe.records: This environment has records in the last 5 minutes.
probe.noRecords: Connected, no records in the last 5 minutes. Check the conditions; this is not an error.
probe.stands: Live stands in the last 7 days: {{list}}

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”
delete.text: The project, its logos and all its catalog records will be deleted permanently. There is no history or trash: it can only be restored from a backup.
delete.counts: Will be deleted: systems {{systems}}, methods {{methods}}, errors {{errors}}, “Unknown” rows {{unknown}}.
delete.countsFailed: Could not get the record counts.

logo.hint: PNG or SVG up to 256 KB. The dark version is optional: without it, the light one is used in both themes.
logo.format: PNG and SVG files are accepted.
logo.tooBig: The file is {{size}} KB, over the {{max}} KB limit.

env.idHint: Latin letters, digits and hyphens: it goes into addresses.
env.idSaved: Cannot change: it is in addresses and colleagues' links.
env.name: Name
env.kindChanged: Old links to this environment will open the stand selection.
env.outOfScope: The environment is not working: its conditions went beyond the backends.{{id}}.formScope boundary. No requests go to log storage, the record is saved. Fix the conditions or ask an administrator to widen the boundary.
env.storeMissingHint: This log storage is no longer in the settings file: choose another.
env.mockFormat: The simulated data is written in a different log format: records may not parse.
env.noScope: Boundary not set: new conditions will not be saved until an administrator sets backends.{{id}}.formScope, for example formScope: { label: namespace, values: [acme, 'acme-*'] }.
env.standHint: With one place for the number: acme-pr-{number}
env.label: Label
env.regexHint: A regular expression over the whole value, like =~ in Grafana: cards|worker.
env.regexNotHint: A regular expression over the whole value, like !~ in Grafana: records with a matching value are not read, for example debug|worker-.*
env.conditionsLimit: No more than {{max}} conditions in an environment.
env.examplesHint: Cards on the environment page before the first search: a click fills in the search bar and searches. A caption for each interface language; if one is empty, both show the other. Everyone who opens the environment sees them: use made-up or test values.
env.examplesLimit: No more than {{max}} examples in an environment.
env.lastHint: The last environment cannot be removed: at least one is needed.
env.envLimit: No more than {{max}} environments in a project.
env.needOne: At least one environment is needed.
env.removedWarning: Will be removed on save: {{list}}. Links to their requests will stop opening.

notFound.title: No such project
notFound.text: Project “{{id}}” is not in the settings.

form.name: Name
form.idHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, up to 32 characters. Cannot change after creation.
form.idSaved: Cannot change: it is in addresses and colleagues' links.
form.formatHint: Format not in the list? An administrator describes it in the formats section, checks it with pnpm threadline:check <format> <file> and restarts the server.
form.formatMissing: {{name}}: this format is no longer in the file
form.hasErrors: Fix the errors in the fields.
form.leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave the page?

validation.idRule: ID: lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, not starting with a hyphen, up to 32 characters.
validation.idReserved: This ID is taken by a page address, choose another.
validation.idDigits: An ID cannot be digits only: the project order would not be preserved.
validation.envIdRule: ID: lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, not starting with a hyphen, up to 32 characters.
validation.envIdReserved: This ID is taken by a project page address, choose another.
validation.envIdDigits: An ID cannot be digits only: the order of such an environment would not be preserved.
validation.envIdRepeat: This ID already exists in this project.

problem.conflict: The project was changed while you were editing it.
problem.duplicate: Project “{{id}}” already exists, it may be hidden.
problem.limit: There are already {{max}} projects, including hidden ones: a new one cannot be created.
problem.last: The last visible project cannot be hidden.
problem.unavailable: The database is unavailable, try again later.
problem.forbidden: The server refused: your role does not allow this action.

zone.mainHint: Project settings · edited by analysts and administrators
zone.envsHint: Where Threadline reads logs for each environment
zone.viewHint: What is shown in the Detailed and Brief modes
zone.nameHint: Shown in the header and the project list
zone.formatHint: How to read this project’s records

view.boundary: These settings change only how pages look. Hidden content stays in the browser and opens with the mode switch; only masking protects data.
view.defaultModeHint: Applies to those who have not chosen a mode in this browser yet.
view.statusAlways: Status is always there and comes first, Request ID is always last.
view.requiredColumn: Without this column the row cannot be read: it cannot be turned off.
view.defaultTabMoved: The selected tab is off in both modes: “Timeline” opens instead.
view.timelineAlways: The timeline is needed when the diagram fails and for screen readers: it cannot be turned off.
view.rawRequired: An unrecognized record is visible only here: in “Detailed” this block cannot be turned off.

issue.defaulted: Invalid value replaced with the built-in one: {{field}}
issue.unparsed: The settings record was not parsed, built-in values apply

problem.conflict: The settings were changed while you were editing them
problem.unavailable: The database is unavailable, try again later
problem.forbidden: The server refused: your role does not allow this action
